title: Piecewise isometry groups of Euclidean tessellations
summary: Given a tessellation of Euclidean or hyperbolic space, the piecewise isometry group is the group whose elements are given by cutting space into finitely many tessellated convex subsets and gluing them back together. Groups of piecewise isometries of tessellations generalize Houghton's groups and Thompson's group $V$, and for cubical tessellations were studied by Bieri and Sach.
